author: Marlo Lacen
title: Coach's Facebook posts criticizing Karmelo Anthony draws community backlash - NewsBreak
text:
By Marlo Lacen ,
5 hours ago CADDO PARISH, La. (KTAL/KMSS) – Posts made by a Caddo Schools employee about Texas teen Karmelo Anthony are causing a stir on social media. The employee was identified by social media users in the area as a coach at Northwood High School and made two posts related to the teen’s murder conviction. In one post, the employee refers to Anthony as an “aspiring YN“, and in another, he said, “The jury got it right. Wanna be a stepper, go where the steppers go…to jail! Where is this energy when this stuff happens in Shreveport #selectiveoutrage.” Read full article
